title: How to Make Zero-Training Tabular Predictions with NVIDIA Structured Data Models
summary: In this tutorial, we implement Structured Data Models, NVIDIA’s new library that puts several pretrained foundation models for tables behind one PyTorch interface, and use it to make predictions without training.
